jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About August Health

At August Health, our mission is to empower the essential work of caring for our elders.

We achieve this by providing a modern operating platform and electronic health record (EHR) that enables senior living operators to deliver high-quality care with confidence.

Caregivers are the heart of senior living communities, embodying care, compassion, and well-being. Yet, they face increasing challenges—higher resident acuity, complex workflows, and staffing shortages. At August Health, we build tools that simplify their tasks, eliminate inefficiencies, and provide the insights they need to focus on what truly matters—caring for residents.

At August, we strive to live our values each day, in every interaction with our customers and with each other.

  • Be responsible – leave things better than you found them

  • Take ownership – be decisive and take action

  • Be ambitious – build something great

  • Keep an open mindset – communicate candidly and welcome new ideas

  • Be humble – celebrate each others’ successes and learn from our mistakes

  • Stay positive – assume best intent

About the Role

At August, data is one of the biggest reasons customers choose us. Everyone who uses August, from caregivers to executives, relies on data to do their job, and their needs keep growing. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to set the standard for how August turns customer data into insights that drive action.

You’ll build the metrics, reports, and models behind our Insights product, helping senior living operators understand their performance and spot problems early. Working with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success, you’ll show communities how data can simplify workflows, reduce administrative burden, and free caregivers to focus on resident care.

What You’ll Do

  • Turn recurring questions into scalable, self-serve reporting so customers and internal teams can find answers without an analyst

  • Define and own metrics that help senior living leaders understand performance and compare across communities, regions, and teams

  • Build and improve data models that connect information across our products and hold up over time

  • Explore trends, patterns, and predictive opportunities in our data, and turn findings into insights customers can act on

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to shape our Insights roadmap and bring data into the product itself

  • Help find new ways for insights to reach people where they work

  • Partner with Customer Success on customer conversations and QBRs, presenting findings as clear, actionable recommendations

  • Scope ambiguous questions from leadership and Customer Success into structured analyses with minimal direction

  • Raise the bar for data quality, documentation, and analytics practices across the team

About You

  • 6+ years of experience as a data analyst, with advanced SQL and database skills

  • Experience writing transformation logic and data pipelines

  • Experience designing data models and metrics that stay accurate over time, not just one-off queries

  • A track record of independently owning analytics projects from ambiguous question to shipped insight

  • Solid understanding of statistics, with some experience building or applying forecasting or predictive models

  • Experience building self-serve reporting with BI tools such as Omni, Looker, or similar

  • Experience presenting to external stakeholders and working directly with customers

  • Strong understanding of data privacy and responsible data stewardship

  • Excellent communication skills: you can make complex data accessible to anyone

  • Healthcare data experience (EHR systems, clinical data, medical terminology) is a plus; senior living experience is a bonus

About our team

Our team brings together deep expertise in technology, healthcare, and company-building. We’ve led teams at Apple, Google, Landmark Health, and Adobe, co-founded and exited multiple companies, shipped products used by hundreds of millions of users, and managed clinical teams caring for thousands of patients.

Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are partnering with some of the largest senior care organizations in the U.S. to transform the future of senior living.

We offer market-competitive compensation based on experience and ability, including significant equity option grants. Our benefits prioritize your well-being with 100% company-paid premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage, along with company contributions to your HSA. We help you plan for the future with a 2% 401(k) match, and support your physical and mental health through services like Rightway Health Advocacy and Spring Health Mental Wellness. Beyond traditional benefits, we offer a flexible time off policy, 100% paid family leave, and all-expenses-paid, in-person company offsites twice a year.

What you’ll do

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll be the trusted advisor helping senior living operators achieve measurable outcomes through August Health. You’ll own the customer relationship from post go live through renewal—driving adoption, engagement, and long-term success. You’ll work cross-functionally with Implementation, Product, and Support teams to ensure each customer realizes the full value of our solution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the main point of contact for assigned customers, building and maintaining strong, long-lasting client relationships.

  • Assess and understand existing customer configurations, workflows, and data structures—identifying the best system configuration approaches to meet evolving customer needs.

  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s goals, business challenges, and success metrics.

  • Rapidly understand how a customer’s current system is configured.

  • Conduct regular check-ins and strategic calls to foster engagement and trust.

  • Drive platform adoption and ensure customers are utilizing key features to achieve ROI

  • Monitor customer health metrics and proactively address risks.

  • Identify early signs of dissatisfaction and work cross-functionally to resolve issues.

  • Identify and nurture opportunities for expansion, including upsells.

  • Lead regular success reviews with key stakeholders to evaluate performance, outcomes, and future goals.

  • Analyze customer data to surface insights, trends, and opportunities for optimization.

  • Partner with customers to define measurable success metrics and report on progress.

  • Advocate for customer needs internally and contribute to product feedback loops

  • Represent the company at customer sites, conferences, and strategic meetings (travel up to 25%)

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in Customer Success, Account Management, Implementation, or a similar function

  • Experience in healthcare or senior living operations is a plus, but not required

  • A customer-obsessed mindset and a track record of helping customers achieve meaningful outcomes

  • Proactive, curious, and continuously looking for ways to improve the customer experience

  • Ability to translate business needs into technical and workflow requirements

  • Exceptional communication and relationship management skills, with a demonstrated ability to engage, influence, and build trust with diverse stakeholders—including C-level executives

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change; able to create structure, make decisions, and move forward without perfect information

About our team

Our team brings together deep expertise in technology, healthcare, and company-building. We’ve led teams at Apple, Google, Landmark Health, and Adobe, co-founded and exited multiple companies, shipped products used by hundreds of millions of users, and managed clinical teams caring for thousands of patients.

Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are partnering with some of the largest senior care organizations in the U.S. to transform the future of senior living.

We offer market-competitive compensation based on experience and ability, including significant equity option grants. Our benefits prioritize your well-being with 100% company-paid premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage, along with company contributions to your HSA. We help you plan for the future with a 2% 401(k) match, and support your physical and mental health through services like Rightway Health Advocacy and Spring Health Mental Wellness. Beyond traditional benefits, we offer a flexible time off policy, 100% paid family leave, and all-expenses-paid, in-person company offsites twice a year.

jobs.title: Director of Implementation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About August Health

At August Health, our mission is to empower the essential work of caring for our elders.

We achieve this by providing a modern operating platform and electronic health record (EHR) that enables senior living operators to deliver high-quality care with confidence.

Caregivers are the heart of senior living communities, embodying care, compassion, and well-being. Yet, they face increasing challenges—higher resident acuity, complex workflows, and staffing shortages. At August Health, we build tools that simplify their tasks, eliminate inefficiencies, and provide the insights they need to focus on what truly matters—caring for residents.

At August, we strive to live our values each day, in every interaction with our customers and with each other.

  • Be responsible – leave things better than you found them

  • Take ownership – be decisive and take action

  • Be ambitious – build something great

  • Keep an open mindset – communicate candidly and welcome new ideas

  • Be humble – celebrate each others’ successes and learn from our mistakes

  • Stay positive – assume best intent

About the Role

As Director of Implementation, you will lead the team responsible for taking customers from signed contract through successful go-live—and for implementing new products, communities, acquisitions, and other expansions for customers already live on August Health.

This is both a leadership and builder role. You’ll be responsible for the people, strategy, processes, and systems behind how we implement August Health as we continue to scale. You'll develop a deep understanding of our customers and our entire platform, enabling you to coach the team, navigate our most complex implementations, identify opportunities to improve how we work, and partner closely with teams across August.

We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable leading a team, diving into the details, and building what doesn’t exist yet. You won't carry a traditional Implementation Manager book of business, but you should be capable of stepping into an implementation, understanding the customer and configuration, and helping drive it forward when needed.

What You’ll Do

Lead and develop a high-performing Implementation team. Manage and coach Implementation Managers across both net-new and live-customer implementations, creating clarity around expectations, ownership, development, and performance. Build the team and organizational structure needed as August continues to grow.

Own the implementation experience from post-sale through go-live. Be accountable for the strategy and execution behind customer implementations across August's platform, ensuring customers launch successfully and are positioned for long-term success before transitioning to Customer Success. Our current IMs own the full cycle from discovery/configuration through go-live and early stabilization, so this leader needs to understand that work deeply.

Own implementation for customers as they grow and evolve. Oversee implementations for live customers adopting new products, adding communities through organic growth or acquisitions, navigating operator transitions, and otherwise expanding their use of August. These projects often require quickly understanding complex existing configurations and adapting them on accelerated timelines.

Build for scale. Continuously evaluate how we implement and identify opportunities to make the experience more efficient, repeatable, and effective. Develop the processes, playbooks, tooling, metrics, and operating rhythms that allow the team to support increasing customer and product complexity without simply adding headcount.

Develop deep product and implementation expertise. Understand August Health's products, configurations, workflows, integrations, and implementation methodology well enough to coach others, troubleshoot complex situations, challenge assumptions, and step directly into the work when necessary.

Use technology to make the team better. Look beyond traditional process improvements and identify opportunities to automate or eliminate manual work. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be technically curious and comfortable using modern AI and no/low-code tools to prototype solutions, improve internal workflows, and partner effectively with technical teammates to turn ideas into scalable tools.

Be the escalation point for complexity—not simply problems. Help the team navigate ambiguous implementations, challenging customer dynamics, novel configurations, and situations where the existing playbook isn't enough. Create structure, make decisions, and help the team move forward.

Partner across August Health. Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, and Data to ensure clean handoffs, surface customer and implementation insights, influence product priorities, and continuously improve the end-to-end customer journey. Cross-functional partnership is already central to the underlying Implementation Manager roles.

Know what's happening across the portfolio. Build the visibility and operating cadence necessary to understand implementation health, capacity, risks, timelines, and outcomes across the team—and use those insights to proactively address issues and improve our strategy.

The Ideal Candidate

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 7+ years of experience in Implementation, Professional Services, Customer Success, Program Management, or a related customer-facing function, ideally in B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, or another complex software environment

  • Have 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing strong teams and leaders

  • Have led complex, multi-stakeholder software implementations and understand what excellent implementation looks like from both the customer and company perspective

  • Are a builder at heart—you naturally notice inefficient processes, unclear ownership, or missing infrastructure and want to make them better

  • Can move comfortably between strategy and execution: you're capable of designing the implementation operating model in one conversation and digging into the details of a challenging customer configuration in the next

  • Are highly systems-oriented and technically curious; you don't need to be an engineer, but technology and automation are tools you instinctively reach for when solving operational problems

  • Are excited by the potential of AI-assisted tooling and automation and comfortable experimenting with new ways to make teams more effective

  • Can quickly understand complex products, customer workflows, data structures, and system configurations

  • Communicate exceptionally well and can build credibility with everyone from an Implementation Manager to a customer's C-suite

  • Are comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist—a trait already emphasized in the existing enterprise implementation role.

  • Care deeply about the customer experience while also understanding that delivering a great experience at scale requires strong processes, clear expectations, and operational discipline

  • Bring healthcare or senior living experience as a plus, but not necessarily a requirement

About our team

Our team brings together deep expertise in technology, healthcare, and company-building. We’ve led teams at Apple, Google, Landmark Health, and Adobe, co-founded and exited multiple companies, shipped products used by hundreds of millions of users, and managed clinical teams caring for thousands of patients.

Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are partnering with some of the largest senior care organizations in the U.S. to transform the future of senior living.

We offer market-competitive compensation based on experience and ability, including significant equity option grants. Our benefits prioritize your well-being with 100% company-paid premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage, along with company contributions to your HSA. We help you plan for the future with a 2% 401(k) match, and support your physical and mental health through services like Rightway Health Advocacy and Spring Health Mental Wellness. Beyond traditional benefits, we offer a flexible time off policy, 100% paid family leave, and all-expenses-paid, in-person company offsites twice a year.

jobs.title: Customer Systems Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About August Health

At August Health, our mission is to empower the essential work of caring for our elders.

We achieve this by providing a modern operating platform and electronic health record (EHR) that enables senior living operators to deliver high-quality care with confidence.

Caregivers are the heart of senior living communities, embodying care, compassion, and well-being. Yet, they face increasing challenges—higher resident acuity, complex workflows, and staffing shortages. At August Health, we build tools that simplify their tasks, eliminate inefficiencies, and provide the insights they need to focus on what truly matters—caring for residents.

At August, we strive to live our values each day, in every interaction with our customers and with each other.

  • Be responsible – leave things better than you found them

  • Take ownership – be decisive and take action

  • Be ambitious – build something great

  • Keep an open mindset – communicate candidly and welcome new ideas

  • Be humble – celebrate each others’ successes and learn from our mistakes

  • Stay positive – assume best intent

Role Overview

As a Customer Systems Analyst at August Health, you'll play a critical role in helping our Implementation and Customer Success teams deliver a great customer experience by configuring, maintaining, and optimizing our platform.

You'll work behind the scenes to support new customer implementations, data conversions, document digitization, and ongoing system changes for live customers. This includes configuring workflows across our Clinical, Billing, and Move-Ins products, supporting the rollout of new features, and helping customers get more value from the platform over time.

You'll partner closely with our customer-facing teams to translate requirements into accurate, thoughtful system changes. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, technical curiosity, and an understanding of how configuration decisions impact resident data, customer workflows, and the end-user experience.

What You'll Do

  • Execute configuration changes across August Health's Clinical, Billing, and Move-Ins products, supporting both new implementations and existing customers.

  • Support data conversions, document digitization, and other technical setup activities needed to successfully onboard customers and expand their use of the platform.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers to maintain and optimize live customer environments, including configuration updates, new feature rollouts, and initiatives focused on increasing product adoption and value.

  • Understand how system settings and configuration hierarchies interact, including how global, organization-level, and community-level settings translate into the end-user experience.

  • Evaluate the downstream impact of proposed changes on existing workflows, resident data, and system behavior before implementing them.

  • Validate configuration changes for accuracy and completeness, proactively identifying potential issues before they impact customers.

  • Partner closely with Implementation Managers and Customer Success Managers to translate customer requirements, support tickets, and project needs into actionable configuration work.

  • Ask thoughtful questions, identify missing requirements, and push back when proposed changes could create unintended consequences or when a better approach is available.

  • Manage and prioritize work across multiple implementations, live customer requests, and internal initiatives, balancing timelines, complexity, and business impact.

  • Track requests, document configuration decisions, and communicate progress clearly using internal ticketing and project management tools.

  • Collaborate with Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to troubleshoot complex issues, identify recurring patterns, and improve how we deliver configuration services.

  • Help develop and improve internal processes, documentation, and tools that make configuration work more accurate, efficient, and scalable.

Who You Are

  • 2–4 years of experience in a systems analyst, business analyst, implementation, technical operations, or similar role involving hands-on software configuration and data management.

  • Experience working with complex software platforms where system settings, workflows, and data structures interact to drive end-user behavior.

  • Experience working within ticketing or project management systems such as Linear, Intercom, Jira, or Zendesk.

  • Experience with healthcare technology, EHRs, billing systems, or other complex operational software is a plus, but not required.

  • Comfortable navigating complex software products, understanding configuration dependencies and hierarchies, and troubleshooting unexpected system behavior.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills, including working with CSV files, manipulating structured data, validating data accuracy, and identifying inconsistencies.

  • Familiarity with JSON data structures and the ability to read, interpret, and work with structured configuration data. Basic understanding of APIs and data integrations is a plus.

  • Ability to investigate system behavior, assess the impact of changes, and methodically validate that configurations work as intended.

  • Comfortable managing requests through ticketing systems and maintaining clear, accurate documentation of changes and decisions.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to Detail: Takes a careful, methodical approach to configuration changes, recognizing that even small adjustments can have significant downstream effects on live customer environments.

  • Critical Thinking & Judgment: Goes beyond simply executing requests to understand the underlying need, ask the right questions, and recognize when a proposed approach may not be appropriate.

  • Technical Curiosity: Enjoys learning how complex systems work, investigating unexpected behavior, and developing a deep understanding of the product.

  • Ownership & Reliability: Takes responsibility for completing work accurately and on time, managing competing priorities without losing track of details.

  • Cross-Functional Communication: Communicates clearly with customer-facing and technical teammates, translating requirements into actionable work and explaining system behavior in an approachable way.

  • Continuous Improvement: Looks for opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual work, and build more scalable ways of supporting customers as August Health grows.

About our team

Our team brings together deep expertise in technology, healthcare, and company-building. We’ve led teams at Apple, Google, Landmark Health, and Adobe, co-founded and exited multiple companies, shipped products used by hundreds of millions of users, and managed clinical teams caring for thousands of patients.

Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are partnering with some of the largest senior care organizations in the U.S. to transform the future of senior living.

We offer market-competitive compensation based on experience and ability, including significant equity option grants. Our benefits prioritize your well-being with 100% company-paid premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage, along with company contributions to your HSA. We help you plan for the future with a 2% 401(k) match, and support your physical and mental health through services like Rightway Health Advocacy and Spring Health Mental Wellness. Beyond traditional benefits, we offer a flexible time off policy, 100% paid family leave, and all-expenses-paid, in-person company offsites twice a year.

  • Be ambitious – build something great

  • Keep an open mindset – communicate candidly and welcome new ideas

  • Be humble – celebrate each others’ successes and learn from our mistakes

  • Stay positive – assume best intent

About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced Account Manager to join our growing Go-To-Market team and own the commercial relationships with a portfolio of existing customers. You’ll drive retention, renewals, and expansion by building strong executive relationships, understanding customer priorities, and turning demonstrated value into long-term growth.
This role requires a strong seller and strategic account partner who can identify opportunities, build compelling business cases, and lead commercial conversations from discovery through negotiation and close. You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Implementation to align account strategy with customer outcomes, while helping strengthen our Account Management processes as we scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own account strategy, renewals, and expansion for a portfolio of enterprise customers.

  • Build relationships with executive sponsors and key decision-makers, understanding their business priorities, purchasing processes, and growth plans.

  • Identify and close expansion opportunities across additional communities, products, and use cases.

  • Lead commercial discovery, business cases, proposals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and contract execution.

  • Develop proactive account plans that map stakeholders, prioritize opportunities, and establish clear next steps for retention and growth.

  • Partner with Customer Success to translate adoption, outcomes, and customer insights into compelling value stories and expansion recommendations.

  • Lead executive business reviews that connect customer results to strategic priorities and commercial next steps.

  • Maintain accurate account records, opportunity pipelines, and renewal and expansion forecasts.

  • Help improve account planning, commercial handoffs, reporting, and repeatable renewal and expansion processes.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise software account management or a comparable commercial role, with direct responsibility for renewals and expansion. Experience in senior living or healthcare is a plus.

  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding revenue targets through upselling, cross-selling, and renewal execution.

  • Strong consultative selling skills, including discovery, value-based proposals, negotiation, and closing.

  • Proven ability to build executive relationships and navigate complex organizations with multiple stakeholders.

  • Ability to turn customer outcomes and data into clear business cases that support investment decisions.

  • Strong organization and follow-through, with experience managing account plans, pipelines, and forecasts.

  • Experience improving account management processes, playbooks, or reporting as a team scales.

  • Sound judgment and initiative, with the ability to prioritize competing needs and make decisions in a dynamic startup environment.

  • Exceptional communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across teams.

  • Willingness to travel 25%–50%.

About our team

Our team brings together deep expertise in technology, healthcare, and company-building. We’ve led teams at Apple, Google, Landmark Health, and Adobe, co-founded and exited multiple companies, shipped products used by hundreds of millions of users, and managed clinical teams caring for thousands of patients.

Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are partnering with some of the largest senior care organizations in the U.S. to transform the future of senior living.

We offer market-competitive compensation based on experience and ability, including significant equity option grants. Our benefits prioritize your well-being with 100% company-paid premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage, along with company contributions to your HSA. We help you plan for the future with a 2% 401(k) match, and support your physical and mental health through services like Rightway Health Advocacy and Spring Health Mental Wellness. Beyond traditional benefits, we offer a flexible time off policy, 100% paid family leave, and all-expenses-paid, in-person company offsites twice a year.
